subject: Request: Unbundle structuring discount — VP/CFO signoff needed
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Park <samantha@notional.ai>
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal + ask: unbundle pricing for Notional.ai POC

Samantha —

Great to meet you on Wednesday. Per our conversation I'm attaching the baseline proposal for the unbundled offering you asked about (ML inference + prefix cache + 24/7 support). Key commercial ask from your side: a EUR-denominated, three-year committed package with a front-loaded discount at 35% to support the initial POC and procurement timelines.

Attached: Notional_Redwood_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf and the TCO workbook.

Next steps from our side: we need an internal pricing exception for 35% off list for year 1, with scheduled price step-ups in year 2/3. Can you confirm whether your legal/procurement require any alternative termination or audit language?

Thanks — I put Tessa in copy to drive the internal approval.

—Vivek
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: Notional_Redwood_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf (34KB, PDF), TCO_analysis_Notional_Q3.xlsx (12KB, spreadsheet)

From: Samantha Park <samantha@notional.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@notional.ai; legal@notional.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal + ask: unbundle pricing for Notional.ai POC

Vivek —

Thanks, received. Procurement is asking us to secure written signoff for any discount >25% from vendor finance (they flagged your proposed 35%). From our side, the commercial rationale is: 1) Notional is doing a public case study if the POC meets latency and cost targets; 2) we expect expansion to two additional product lines inside 12 months; 3) committed three-year spend.

Legal: we'll aim to keep standard termination (60d) but may push on audit scope — I flagged that to my counsel.

If you can get internal VP/CFO signoff quickly, we can move to DocuSign and aim for PO by Dec 15.

—Samantha
VP Product, Notional.ai

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com; markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: INTERNAL: Notional.ai — request for 35% unbundle discount (need VP/CFO signoff)

Folks —

Summary: Notional (mid-sized AI platform, target customer for our unbundled offering) is asking for a 35% one-year front-loaded discount on a 3-year committed unbundled package for their POC. Vivek attached term sheet and TCO (attached here). They offer strategic value (public case study + multi-product expansion risk). Procurement will only accept discount >25% with written finance signoff; they expect a PO by Dec 15.

Why this is borderline: our standard maximum off-template discount for this packaging is 25% without exec signoff. 35% reduces gross margin materially on an already thin unbundled SKU and sets a precedent if we don't put guardrails in place.

Recommendation / ask: I recommend approving a 30% maximum concession (not the full 35) conditioned on:
- A firm 3-year committed spend with annual spend minimums in the DocuSign term sheet
- No changes to our termination notice (keep 60-day) and no expanded audit rights beyond standard SOC request
- Payment in 30 days (no extended payment terms) and a single PO issued by Dec 15
- A public case study clause (mutually agreed) and a short-term price step-up if expansion occurs (5% uplift in year 2 if usage < projected)

If you approve 30% we can push the remainder of the value into a marketing credit and a success-based expansion credit (not revenue-impacting in year 1).

Attachments: requested_discount_summary.docx; TCO_analysis_Notional_Q3.xlsx

Action requested: markus — can you confirm finance position? lauren — any commercial objection? I'll take point executing once we have signoff.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com; lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Notional.ai — request for 35% unbundle discount (need VP/CFO signoff)

Tessa —

Thanks for the summary. I agree with a capped 30% concession under the conditions you outlined. Two clarifications from finance:
1) We must require the PO to reference the DocuSign term sheet and include a one-time non-refundable onboarding fee (covers reserved slot on Dedicated pool). That onboarding fee must not be waived.
2) Legal must confirm there are no expanded audit or liability clauses. If Legal adds material changes to termination or indemnity, we pull back to 25%.

If both hold, I'm comfortable recommending to Marissa for CFO signoff. Marissa — would you consider final signoff for 30% with the conditions above? If yes, I'll prepare the memo for formal approval.

—Markus
VP Finance

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com; tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com; vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Notional.ai — request for 35% unbundle discount (need VP/CFO signoff)

Team —

I've reviewed the ask, supporting rationale, and finance/legal conditions. Approved: 30% discount cap for Year 1, subject to the following mandatory conditions before deal signature:
- DocuSign term sheet must include the onboarding fee (non-waivable) and the prescribed annual minimum spend language.
- Legal sign-off confirming no expanded termination/audit/indemnity exposure beyond our standard template.
- Payment terms: Net 30 and PO issued by Notional procurement referencing DocuSign ID HP-68247.
- Marketing/case study clause included; marketing credit can be negotiated separately but must not be recorded as revenue deferral in FY26.

Tessa: please coordinate with Legal and Vivek to get the redlines cleared and return the final DocuSign link to finance-approvals@redwood.com for tracking. Once we receive the PO and redline confirmation, I will provide a short CFO approval memo for the deal file.

Marissa Cole
Chief Financial Officer
Redwood Inference
